title: Quick Load: With file from addons in history, disableing `include_addons` leads to error and unexpected behaviour
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in latest dev (4.8.dev7) and latest full release (4.7.2) - GIF [[/ɡɪf/](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:IPA/English)] shows bug in v4.8.dev7.official [c971f93e7] - Bug predates the latest version, afaik exists since rework of the Quick Load dialog with the addition of the "Addons" toggle [06791e1] ### System information Godot v4.8.dev7 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (3840x2160 @ 144.00 Hz, 2880x1800 @ 59.95 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8157) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11700 @ 2.50GHz (16 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Naming is inconsistent, using "Quick Load" here, but also elsewhere referred to as "Quick Open", all talking about the dialog used for quickly selecting resources under type constraints, usually in the inspector. ## Description Once a Resource from the addons folder was selected through the Quick Load dialog, it is saved in the history. This leads to an error when having "Addons" disabled in the menu, the dialoge tries to still show the resource from history, can't and overrides other (search) results that would otherwise be shown. ## Expectation Files from the addons folder should not be shown when "Addons" is disabled, even when the resource is in Quick Open history ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open [mrp](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32981828/mrp-quick-load-addons-bug.zip) 2. View `test_quick_load.tscn` in Editor, select node such that Inspector shows `TextureRect` 3. Click on Quick Load Icon or select it from the dropdown, on the `texture` property. 4. Toggle on "Addons" toggle button and select addons_icon 5. Reopen Quick Load through dropdown or reset property and use Quick Load button again. 6. Toggle off "Addons" toggle 7. Notice how an error is thrown (`ERROR: editor/gui/editor_quick_open_dialog.cpp:736 - EditorQuickOpenDialog: No type for path res://addons/my_addon/addon_icon.svg.`) and the shown icons are not the expected `icon.svg` and `icon2.svg`, but the icon in the addons folder and `icon.svg` Note: This bug is related to stuff changing in the Quick Load history, meaning it depends on the `.godot` folder. Trying to perform this bug multiple times without clearing the `.godot` folder in between makes steps 3 and 4 unnecessary, because the icon from addons is already saved in Quick Load history. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp-quick-load-addons-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32981828/mrp-quick-load-addons-bug.zip)
